storyCards.headline: Beat It: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Michael Jackson's "Beat It" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Beat It" is a song by American singer Michael Jackson from his sixth studio album, Thriller (1982).

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 25 weeks on the chart.

Beat It was released in 2003.
